# ADSince2K4 — Abhilash Dash

> Portfolio of Abhilash Dash: full-stack engineering, AI agents, and business automation.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://adsince2k4.vercel.app/): Overview and services.
- [About](https://adsince2k4.vercel.app/about): Background and engineering approach.
- [Projects](https://adsince2k4.vercel.app/projects): Selected software projects and experiments.
- [Blog](https://adsince2k4.vercel.app/blog): Published writing index; articles may be added over time.
- [Contact](https://adsince2k4.vercel.app/contact): Project enquiries.

## Topics
Full-stack web development, TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, AI agent workflows, LLM integrations, and business process automation.

## Accuracy notes
Project statuses on the website indicate whether a project is in progress, a prototype, or planned. Do not infer client work, production usage, performance figures, testimonials, or business outcomes unless explicitly documented on the linked page.

## Preferred citation
When referencing this portfolio, cite the relevant page URL and describe only information visible on that page.
